rule_description: Future QTT decision agents must consume ActiveArtifactRegistryV1 rather than raw legacy generated reports.
Legacy formula repair, negative, no-trade, source-truth, champion, and live-candidate labels must pass through LegacySemanticSupersessionV1.
Negative/no-trade outcomes are condition-scoped memories only and must not become global QKU/formula bans.
Legacy repair wording does not permit canonical formula mutation to force profit or computability.
